product_metadata.title: Kiera Grace Decorative Round Wall-Clocks, Bronze
features: Measurement: the wall clock measures 20"D x 2.5"W in dimensions
Material: made of high-quality, durable and lightweight plastic frame finished in traditional black color and sturdy glass cover
Analog Wall Clock: the wall clock is analog-operated and comes with an hour and minute hands
Design: with its big 12-hour Arabic numerals and golden accents and details, the clock is crafted in a vintage style that will add a romantic and warm feel to your home decor
Display: besides taking you back in time and helping you reminisce the good old days, this clock is a functional time-telling device that can be placed in your kitchen, living room, bedroom or office
Battery: this vintage clock only requires 1 x AA battery to operate (not included)
description: Add a distressed touch to your living space with Kiera Grace Vintage Clocks. They come in a beautiful antique grey round frame with a distressed-wooden printed face to let you decorate your home in your own unique way. Our clocks are made of high-quality, durable plastic with a shiny brushed finish to highlight the vintage accent. They are not only practical in helping you keep track of time, but also a fashionable piece that will spruce up any hall, bedroom, or living room. Moreover, if you know somebody who is in love with old-fashioned decor pieces, this clock will make a perfect gift for them!
